question: A handler does `configuration["IngestToken"]` inside business logic to read a secret on every call. What is wrong and what is the idiomatic fix (options pattern)? Name the exact API used to fail fast at startup.

A pull request adds `public interface IStarSearchService` with exactly one implementation and no test fake. Is the interface justified? Give the rule and the two exceptions where a single-impl interface IS correct.

A lookup table of 200 skill names -> ids is built with `new Dictionary<string,int>(data)` on every request. What collection type should this be, when should it be constructed, and why (read performance characteristics)?
